欢迎阅读 OpenFoD 项目文档。OpenFoD 是开源重铸的《傲世三国》（F: Welcome to the OpenFoD docs. OpenFoD is an open-source recast of Fate of the Dragon (傲世三国): city governance, officer recruitment, and three combat layers rebuilt for modern engines so the game can be played, forked, and passed on.
本站分成两部分：面向玩家的 **用户使用文档**，以及面向贡献者的 **开发者文: This site has two halves: a **user guide** for players, and a **developer guide** for contributors. The compiled site is published at `https://www.openfod.org/docs/`.

OpenFoD 是社区主导的开源重铸，目标是让 2001 年目标软件奥世工作室的: OpenFoD is a community-led open-source recast. The goal is to make Object Software’s 2001 Fate of the Dragon (傲世三国) playable on modern systems. It is not a rerelease and it does not ship commercial data packs.
原作不是红警式的纯兵线对冲，也不走三国志的回合棋盘。玩家同时治理一座城、注视一片: The original is not a Red Alert arms race, nor a Romance of the Three Kingdoms board. You govern a city and watch a realm at once: taxes, morale, farming and Hanlin research inside the walls; field battles, sieges and street fighting beyond them.
它是第一款在 E3 正式展出的中国游戏，后由 Eidos 以 Fate of t: It was the first Chinese game formally shown at E3, later published by Eidos as Fate of the Dragon. Two decades on, the original strains against modern OS and resolutions. OpenFoD exists to light that city again.

《傲世三国》最被记住的不是兵种表，而是 **城中之城**。战略大地图上，城池只是: What Fate of the Dragon is remembered for is not a unit roster, but the **city within a city**. On the campaign map a city is a silhouette; step inside and farms, markets, temples, barracks and the prefecture hall unfold together.
同一战区有两类图：: A theater has two kinds of map:
**城市图**：只在城里建造。雷达通常在左边。: **City map**: you only build inside the city. The radar is usually on the left.
**战区图**：野外遭遇与攻城。雷达通常在右边。: **Field map**: encounters and sieges. The radar is usually on the right.
部队可以在图与图之间行军。最多 8 座城出现在同一战区，用底部按钮切换。: Armies can march between maps. Up to eight cities share a theater; switch with the buttons at the bottom.
人口依赖治安，税收依赖人口与税率。粮食沿「稻 → 主食 → 军粮 / 体力」走；: Population depends on public order; tax depends on population and the rate. Grain follows rice → staple food → army rations / stamina; wine restores city hit points; cloth is one production branch; coin comes from tax and the market.
民夫从牌楼招募，可并行排队。建筑只能建在城内空地，并消耗资源。部分建筑有前置：例: Peasants are recruited at the archway and can queue in parallel. Buildings only go on empty city tiles and cost resources. Some have prerequisites: swordsman barracks before spear or bow barracks; an upgraded Hanlin Academy before the inn and stables.
市场可以买入和卖出。分工与赈济影响民心和治安。税率过高会伤民心；祭祀可安民，灾荒: The market buys and sells. Labour assignment and relief affect morale and order. High tax hurts morale; rites calm the people; famine can turn them.
教程里的四个国家官职：: The four state offices from the tutorial:
提高治安，进而提高人口与税: Raise public order, then population and tax
解锁二、三级翰林科技: Unlock second- and third-tier Hanlin techs
国家级祭祀：恢复、增产、减灾: State rites: recovery, yield, fewer disasters
民间祭祀与官方祭祀是两条指令。天灾作为随机事件存在，祭祀降低其概率。: Folk rites and official rites are separate commands. Disasters are random events; rites lower their chance.
翰林院不消耗民夫。四个分类加上升级，最多升到三级院。关卡可以锁升级。: The Hanlin Academy does not consume peasants. Four categories plus an upgrade, up to a tier-3 academy. Scenarios can lock upgrades.
研究满 4 个一级科技后开放二级: Research four tier-1 techs to open tier 2
二级再满 4 个后开放三级: Four more at tier 2 opens tier 3
翰林院本身升级是建造客栈等高级建筑的门闩: Upgrading the academy itself is the gate for the inn and other advanced buildings
战事分成三层：郊外野战、城墙攻防、破门之后的巷战。粮道一断，再强的军阵也会溃散。: War has three layers: open-field battles, wall assault, and street fighting after the gate falls. Cut the grain road and even a famous host dissolves.
操作是经典即时战略：左键选择，右键下令，拖框多选。选中民夫时脚下是绿圈，选中建筑: Controls are classic RTS: left-click select, right-click order, drag a box to multi-select. Selected peasants get a green ring; buildings get a rectangle.
命令来自一张约 100 个 ID 的动作表，界面只是这些动作的皮肤。高频动作包括: Orders come from an action table of about 100 IDs; the UI is only a skin. Frequent verbs include produce, build, demolish, repair, recruit, research, trade, mount/dismount, board ships, camp, siege engines, and diplomacy.
步兵三条线：刀、枪、弓。必须由民夫进入对应兵营训练，并消耗资源。: Infantry has three lines: sword, spear, bow. Peasants must train in the matching barracks and spend resources.
骑兵不是单独兵种：步兵或武将右键马匹即可上马。文官和异人不能上马。: Cavalry is not a separate unit type: infantry or generals right-click a horse to mount. Civil officers and unusual characters cannot mount.
头顶蓝条是 **体力**。己方城内进食恢复；城外随时间下降。降到 0 后训练度开: The blue bar overhead is **stamina**. It recovers by eating in a friendly city and drops in the field. At 0, training starts to fall. Both stamina and training affect attack and defence.
脚下绿条是 **生命**。城内用酒恢复。盟友城内可以吃饭回体力，但不能用酒回生命: The green bar at the feet is **hit points**. Wine restores them in your city. In an ally city you can eat to recover stamina, but you cannot use wine to restore hit points.
国家祭祀可立刻恢复体力与生命。: State rites can restore stamina and hit points immediately.
攻城常用云梯、投石、弩车、霹雳车。水战有草船、楼船、码头停靠与上下船。行营可以扎: Sieges use ladders, catapults, crossbow carts and thunder carts. Naval war has straw boats, tower ships, docks and boarding. Field camps can be pitched, struck, and sortied, and can ship supplies to a city or camp.
外交五件套：结盟、解盟、进献或进贡、支援、离间。它们和内政官职、武将忠诚缠在一起: Five diplomatic acts: ally, break alliance, tribute, support, and alienate. They tangle with offices and officer loyalty; they are not a separate victory-screen button.
文官治城，武将破阵。三国的故事不在数值表里，而在人心向背。: Civil officers run the city; generals break the line. The Three Kingdoms live in hearts, not only in stat sheets.
客栈招募武将，不耗民夫，耗钱。同时最多 3 名待招武将，并定期刷新；门外灯亮表示: The inn recruits officers for coin, not peasants. At most three candidates wait and refresh on a timer; a lit lantern means someone is there. The Hanlin Academy must be upgraded before you can build an inn.
原作人物表从具名武将开始记录曹操、夏侯惇、吕布、诸葛亮等三百余人，并与民夫、士兵: The original table records 300+ named officers from Cao Cao, Xiahou Dun, Lü Bu and Zhuge Liang onward, sharing one entity layout with peasants, soldiers and engines, distinguished by type bits. The three kinds are:
**武将**：可上阵、可单挑、可劝降: **Generals**: field command, duels, and persuasion to defect
赐爵、赏赐与宝物维系忠诚。忠诚影响生产与战斗效率。战场上可以单挑，也可以劝降。流: Titles, gifts and relics hold loyalty. Loyalty affects production and combat. You can duel or persuade defections in the field. Losing a core officer often hurts more than losing a barracks.
184 年黄巾之后，汉廷名存。三位雄主各自写下统一的方法——权谋、仁德，或据江自: After the Yellow Turbans in 184, the Han court was a name. Three houses wrote three ways to reunify the realm — cunning, virtue, or the river. Campaigns follow Shu, Wei and Wu, plus training scenarios.
北地苦寒，铁骑与屯田并重。曹魏以权谋开局：铁矿充足，冶铸先行，瓮城与箭塔把中原变: The north is iron, horse and winter. Wei opens with statecraft: abundant ore, early smelting, barbicans and towers that turn the Central Plains into a precise war engine.
巴蜀四塞，农桑为本。蜀汉靠仁德聚人心、靠山地设伏。火油、拒马与粮产，是一条更慢、: The basin is walled by mountains, and agriculture is the root. Shu gathers hearts by virtue and fights from the slopes. Fire oil, chevaux-de-frise and grain — a slower road, harder to cut.
江东以舟楫立国。港口、连环船与水上箭塔改写了中原那套步骑逻辑——谁控住大江，谁就: Jiangdong is a kingdom of hulls. Ports, chained ships and river towers rewrite the north’s infantry logic — who holds the great river holds the fortune of the southeast.
想先学会内政与屯田：魏: Learn city economy and military farms first: Wei
想打粮道与山地防守：蜀: Fight grain roads and mountain defence: Shu
想学水战与港口节奏：吴: Learn naval war and port tempo: Wu

**一个事实一个权威**（ADR 0003）：数值在 ``classic/dat: **One authority per fact** (ADR 0003): numbers live in ``classic/data``. Runtime code must not hide a second copy, and must not bake in a developer’s machine path.
表现属于 ``client/``，磁盘格式属于 ``classic/``，规则属: Presentation belongs in ``client/``, on-disk formats in ``classic/``, rules in ``engine/``.

做法（ADR 0005）：**不要链接两套引擎。分开驱动，对比 transcri: The method (ADR 0005): **do not link the engines. Drive them separately and compare transcripts.**
**场景是数据不是代码。** JSON 描述地图、刷兵、带时间戳的命令和要跑多久: **A scenario is data, not code.** JSON describes maps, spawns, tick-stamped commands and how long to run. No C# type names appear, so an architectural rewrite does not destroy the spec.
**Transcript 是规范投影。** 每个观察到的 tick 一条记录，单: **A transcript is a canonical projection.** One record per observed tick, units sorted by id, fixed field order, LF line endings, no timestamps. Two runs of the same engine must be byte-identical, or the oracle is noise.
**Diff 必须写明容忍项。** 差异要么报出来，要么列出容忍理由。被容忍的差: **A diff must name what it tolerates.** Differences are reported or listed with a reason. A tolerated difference is a recorded divergence.
两个 runner 只共享场景模型和 transcript 模型。: The two runners share the scenario and transcript model and nothing else.
``parity/`` 是过渡目录。等价性成立之后应当删除，而不是永远堆着两套世: ``parity/`` is transitional. Delete it once equivalence is established; do not keep two worlds forever.
原作安装不是单一资源包，而是小引擎加散落数据再加巨型资源 DLL。OpenFoD: The original install is not one asset pack: a small engine, scattered data, and huge resource DLLs. OpenFoD **reads the spec and does not commit original files**.

OpenFod-Docs 参考 ProteinSeek Workbench Do: OpenFod-Docs follows ProteinSeek Workbench Docs for **Sphinx + an in-repo theme + zh/en + Ask AI**, but **does not use Docker / GHCR / Nginx**. Static HTML is pulled by OpenFod-Website’s GitHub Pages workflow and placed at ``/docs/``.
可选：本地 Ask AI 走 Node 服务（只用于本机，密钥不要提交）：: Optional: local Ask AI via the Node service (machine-local only; do not commit secrets):
生产环境禁止把上述三个值写入 OpenFod-Docs 或 OpenFoD-Go: Do not write those three values into OpenFod-Docs or OpenFoD-Godot for production. The website build reads Environment secrets on OpenFod-Website: ``LLM_BASE_URL``, ``LLM_APIKEY``, ``LLM_MODEL``.
GitHub Pages 上没有常驻 Node 进程。Ask AI 会先尝试同源: GitHub Pages has no standing Node process. Ask AI first tries same-origin ``/docs/api/ai-qa/chat``; if that is unavailable it falls back to the static retrieval index shipped with the site (``/docs/ai/index/``). When the secrets exist at build time, a FAQ cache can also be generated to improve static answers.
在 ``OpenFod-Docs`` 的 ``develop`` 写文档、跑 `: Write docs on ``OpenFod-Docs`` ``develop`` and run ``make html``.
``main`` 上的 ``trigger-website`` 工作流调用 ``: The ``trigger-website`` workflow on ``main`` dispatches the OpenFod-Website Pages workflow.
Website 在 ``main`` 构建时检出 Docs 的 ``main``: When Website ``main`` builds, it checks out Docs ``main``, runs ``make html``, copies ``build/html`` into ``dist/docs/``, then publishes GitHub Pages.
``OpenFod-Website`` 的 ``develop`` 同样会检出: ``OpenFod-Website`` ``develop`` also checks out Docs ``develop`` for an integration build, but **does not** publish Pages. The public site updates only from Website ``main``.
跨仓触发需要在 OpenFod-Docs 配置 secret ``WEBSITE: Cross-repo dispatch needs secret ``WEBSITE_DISPATCH_TOKEN`` on OpenFod-Docs (a token that can ``workflow_dispatch`` ``openfod/OpenFod-Website``). If OpenFod-Docs is private, OpenFod-Website also needs ``DOCS_CHECKOUT_TOKEN`` with ``contents:read`` on that repository. The Website repository reads LLM secrets; the Docs repository does not store them.
